resources.string: Enables automatic scrolling in vertical-video apps (Reels, TikTok, Shorts). AutoScroller only performs scroll gestures; it does not read, store or transmit your content.
AutoScroller automates scrolling in vertical-video apps to improve accessibility and digital wellbeing.
This software is distributed under the Apache 2.0 license, \"as-is\", without any express or implied warranty.

Prolonged use of vertical-video content can affect your wellbeing. AutoScroller is not responsible for the content it scrolls through or for the time you spend using third-party apps. Set a healthy time limit in the settings.

AutoScroller stores usage statistics —duration of each session, number of swipes and the app it was used in— only on your device. This data is not sent to any server or shared with third parties, and the app does not access the content you view. If cloud sync or data collection is offered in the future, it will always be optional and require your explicit consent.
To use AutoScroller you need to enable its accessibility service. Tap the button below, find \"AutoScroller\" in the list and turn on the toggle.
